challenged_claim: Every symmetric A with s3(A)>=1 admits a nonzero physical scalar pivot whose Schur complement has a rank-two disjoint original-coordinate cross block with a dimension-free quantitative resource.
correction: False even qualitatively. For the exact target family A_m from account01/B19 with spectrum {1,1,-1}, only Z coordinates have nonzero diagonal. Pivoting any Z coordinate cancels the entire residual Z block and leaves only the 0-Y star, every disjoint cross block of which has rank at most one. Coordinates 0 and Y have zero diagonal and cannot be used as scalar pivots. This is not a QFORM counterexample: the same family is uniformly controlled after high-cardinality product-preserving aggregation as 2 X0 Y_m + Z_m^2.
